## EDA in R (Full Script)

```{r}
# EDA in R (full script)
project_csv <-read.csv("C:/Users/tyler/OneDrive/Documents/GitHub/Classes Spring 2026/BDA Spring 26/project.csv",header=TRUE) # FORWARD SLASH AND HEADER TRUE IF HAVE COLUMN NAMES
# column names
colnames(project_csv)
#head of the data
head(project_csv)
#summary of the days_duration column
summary(project_csv$days_duration)
#summary of the project_csv_cost column
summary(project_csv$project_csv_cost)
# mean of columns
mean(project_csv$days_duration)
mean(project_csv$project_csv_cost)
# stand dev of columns
sd(project_csv$days_duration)
sd(project_csv$project_csv_cost)
# finding the regression line 
mean(project_csv$days_duration)+3*sd(project_csv$days_duration)
mean(project_csv$days_duration)-3*sd(project_csv$days_duration)
mean(project_csv$project_csv_cost)+3*sd(project_csv$project_csv_cost)
mean(project_csv$project_csv_cost)-3*sd(project_csv$project_csv_cost)
#histogram
hist(project_csv$days_duration)
hist(project_csv$project_cost)
#plot with ab line
plot(project_csv$days_duration,type="b")
abline(h=mean(project_csv$days_duration))
plot(project_csv$project_cost,type="b")
abline(h=mean(project_csv$project_csv_cost))
#correlation
cor(project_csv$days_duration,project_csv$project_cost)
plot(project_csv$days_duration,project_csv$project_cost)
```

```{r}
df <-read.csv("C:/Users/tyler/OneDrive/Documents/GitHub/work_to_show/Classes Spring 2026/BDA Spring 26/student data for EDA.csv",header=TRUE) # FORWARD SLASH AND HEADER TRUE IF HAVE COLUMN NAMES
```
